home.calls.b: Up to 60 frames a second, and you can zoom into someone's screen while they share it.
home.calls.body: Voice, video and screen share with sound, encrypted the whole way, from any conversation.
home.calls.c: Send a guest link and someone without an account joins the call, and only the call.
home.calls.title: Call anyone, share anything
home.compare.body: The short version, against the app most people are coming from.
home.compare.emojiEverywhere: Your emoji in every server and DM
home.compare.guests: Call guests with no account at all
home.compare.lock: A passcode on the app itself
home.compare.noEmail: Sign up without an email address
home.compare.packs: Sticker packs that travel between servers
home.compare.subchats: Side conversations with their own key and password
home.compare.title: What is different
home.end.body: A username, a password, and about a minute.
home.express.body: Build emoji and sticker packs, share one with a link, and install anyone else's. They work in every server and every message, animated ones included, with no tier to buy and no limit on how many you keep.
home.express.title: Your emoji, everywhere
home.foot.tagline: Nexa. End to end encrypted chat, voice and servers.
home.hero.fine: No email address. A username and a password, and you are in.
home.hero.lede: Messages, files and calls are encrypted on your device with keys the server never holds. Everything else is the chat app you already know, with the parts it is missing filled in.
home.hero.title: Chat that nobody else can read.
home.point.encryptedBody: Every message, file and call is encrypted on your device. The server keeps ciphertext it cannot read, and private channels carry keys of their own that change the moment someone loses access.
home.point.exportBody: Export your profile, friends, servers and every message you hold a key for, decrypted on your device into a zip. Nothing is decrypted on the server to do it.
home.point.guestsBody: A guest link gets someone into a call in seconds, encrypted like everyone else, with no access to anything but the call.
home.point.languagesBody: The whole app, properly translated, with the plural rules each language actually uses. Arabic reads right to left, and the layout goes with it.
home.point.lockBody: A passcode that never leaves the device, on a timer or the moment you look away. Your keys go with it.
home.point.noEmailBody: Signing up asks for a username and a password. No address to confirm, no phone number, nothing to leak later.
home.point.packsBody: Make a pack, share it with a link, and anyone can install it and use it anywhere. They are not stuck inside the server they came from.
home.point.presenceBody: The desktop app picks up Rich Presence from your games and music and passes it to Discord as well, so you do not have to choose which one to run.
home.point.previewsBody: The server fetches the page and hands you the preview, so the site you linked never sees your address. GIF search works the same way.
home.point.previewsTitle: Link previews that do not out you
home.point.searchBody: Searching runs on your device over the messages it has decrypted, with from:, in:, has: and dates. The server could not help even if it wanted to.
home.point.subchatsBody: Start a side conversation inside any channel or DM. It has its own encryption key, and you can put a password on it so only the people you tell can open it.
home.point.zoomBody: Pinch or scroll to zoom a shared screen, a camera, a picture or a GIF, and drag it around while you are in there.

home.speed.body: The whole app is smaller than one photo. It opens before you have let go of the mouse, and moving between channels is instant because the messages are already here and already decrypted.
home.speed.title: It is quick, and you will feel it

legal.aboutIntro: Nexa is a small chat service run by one person. Below are the same Terms and Privacy Policy you agreed to when you created your account (version {version}).
legal.encryptionBody: Your messages, files, and calls are encrypted on your device before they are sent, using keys the server never has. I cannot read them, I cannot monitor them, and there is no switch that would let me. The only things I can actually see are your public profile (things like your username, display name, avatar, banner, and about me), the basic delivery details the server needs to work (who sent what, where, and when), and public images like emoji and stickers.
legal.enforcementBody: Since chats are encrypted, I cannot see what anyone says in messages, files, or calls, so I do not go looking. The exception is usernames, avatars, and banners. Those are public, so they are the only things I moderate directly. Anything else only comes up if I receive a valid legal order, and even then I can only share what the server actually holds. Message text, file contents, and call audio still cannot be handed over, because I have no way to read them.
legal.gateCheck: I have read the Terms and the Privacy Policy, and I agree to the rules.
legal.gateIntro: One quick thing before you continue. Please read and agree to the Terms ({version}). The short version: your messages are encrypted so nobody here can read them, including me.
legal.gatePrivacy: No email, no phone number, nothing sold, nothing tracked. The Privacy Policy lists exactly what the server keeps.
legal.gateTitle: Agree to the Terms to continue
legal.inApp: you can also message me in the app: {user}
legal.privacyNever: Things I never collect: your email address, phone number, real name, payment details, location, contacts, analytics, push tokens, search history, drafts, or backups. Search happens on your own device, using messages it already decrypted.
legal.privacySummary: Your messages, files, calls, settings, password, recovery key, and encryption keys are either encrypted end to end or never leave your device. There is no spare key lying around, and no way to intercept future chats in readable form.
legal.privacyVisible: What I can see: your public profile, public images (avatars, banners, emoji, stickers), the delivery details the server needs (who sent what, where, and when, plus mentions, reactions, and sizes), your servers and memberships, and one session entry per device (the IP is noted once at sign in and never updated).
legal.ruleCopyright: Respect copyright. Only share things you have the right to share.
legal.ruleGore: No gore or extreme graphic content.
legal.ruleHate: No hate. Racist, homophobic, transphobic, or otherwise hateful usernames, avatars, banners, or harassment are not allowed. That includes slurs and dehumanizing attacks.
legal.ruleIllegal: Keep it legal. No CSAM, exploitation, terrorism, trafficking, fraud, or credible threats of violence.
legal.termsAccounts: Signing up only asks for a username, a display name, and a password. Please look after your password and your recovery key. If you lose both, your messages are gone for good, since there is no way for me to recover them. This is a one person project, provided as is.
legal.termsUse: Please do not spam, scrape, or try to break the service or anyone else's security. The full Terms and Privacy Policy are always available at chat.evilion.xyz/terms and chat.evilion.xyz/privacy.
legal.termsWhat: Nexa is a small chat service run by one person. By creating an account, you agree to these Terms and to the Privacy Policy.
